cost: Euclid O(log magnitude) big divisions, modpow O(log|e|) ring operations; CRT one gcd/inverse per pair. Sieve O(n log log n)/O(n), cached small primes to1e6. Factor cost includes trial, recursive primality and Pollard without strict total time cap. Divisors materializes tau(n) values and sorts O(tau log tau), unchecked u128 count product. Digit conversion/repeated division and Horner have operand-width costs.
description: gcd returns0 for (0,0), otherwise uses dashu, ext_gcd iterates independent Euclid and lcm handles zero. mod_floor normalizes modulo|m|; modpow uses inverse for negative exponents, rejects m=0 and short-circuits m=1 to0. CRT joins noncoprime congruences with difference divisibility and lcm modulus. Primality uses12 fixed bases for u64,30 plus trial/Pocklington for bigger values. factor strips sign, trial-divides and Pollard-splits, then sorts/merges; probable factors count complete. Multiplicative functions consume factors; digits emits |n| digits, from_digits unrestricted Horner sum.

inverse: CRT (x,M) admits all nonempty matched congruence arrays whose lcm is M and residues agree modulo|mi|, including signs/order/redundancies. Factor list reconstructs magnitude, losing sign; empty list admits0 and±1 under producer conventions. Canonical digits recover magnitude but lose sign; unrestricted from_digits has many noncanonical antecedents. Probable verdict does not recover an integer or proof.
